data.body_html:
Planning a stag weekend yacht budget Marbella 2032 requires knowing exactly what you’ll pay — and what’s included. This breakdown covers every cost, from the cheapest 2-hour spin on an Astondoa 40 (€749) to a full-day blowout on a Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski (€4,719 for 4 hours). No hidden fees, no fluff. Whether you’re a group of 8 or 12, here’s how to budget for a day on the water in Puerto Banús.

Stag Weekend Yacht Budget Marbella 2032: Tier A Boats

Tier A boats are the most affordable option for stag groups. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) both cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. This price includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and 21% Spanish VAT. Perfect for a half-day party without breaking the bank.

Premium Option: Mangusta 80 Stag Charter

If your group wants to impress, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. That includes a free jet ski — a huge hit for stag parties. The white and grey variants are identical in price and specs. For longer durations, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. This is the flagship stag experience in Marbella.

What’s Included in Every Stag Yacht Charter

Every booking includes: a licensed skipper, fuel, water + soft drinks + beer + white wine + cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden costs. Optional extras like catering (€30–€60/pax), water toys, and transport from your hotel can be added. You can also bring your own food and extra drinks.

Other Boats for Stag Groups

For groups of up to 12, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), or Maiora 26m. All depart from Puerto Banús and include the same standard inclusions. For smaller groups, the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) or Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) are excellent choices. Pricing for these boats is on request via WhatsApp.

Deposit and Cancellation Policy

To secure your booking, we require a 50% deposit via bank transfer. The balance is due 14 days before departure. Cancellations made more than 30 days in advance receive a full refund minus a 5% admin fee. Within 30 days, the deposit is non-refundable. We recommend taking out travel insurance for peace of mind.

Best Time to Book a Stag Yacht in Marbella

Peak season is June to September, with sea temperatures above 22°C and 12 hours of sunshine. For lower rates, consider May or October — still warm, but fewer crowds. Avoid November to February if swimming or sunbathing is a priority. Book at least 4–6 weeks in advance for peak dates.

Departure Points and Itineraries

All charters depart from Puerto Banús, a 10-minute walk from the Golden Mile. You can also start from Marbella Marina or Cabopino by prior arrangement. Popular stag itineraries include cruising past La Concha, stopping at Cala del Faro for a swim, and heading to Estepona for lunch. Your skipper will tailor the route to your group.
